name: Nikukai no Eden Touketsu Shoujo no Niku Ingoku
original_name: 肉塊の淫獄 凍結少女の肉淫獄
source:
Mysterious flesh wriggles in the resin-slicked grimy underground sanctuary.
Freeze girl Kula was powerless before the propagating horror.
She resisted desperately... soaked in a shower of mucosa, she ran for her life... the eager tentacles wuld not let her.

In the end, as the maw engulfed her body... disgraced in heart and soul, drowned in the fluids and tongues from both ends in this holy place...

It came to her, plunged inside...

The inescapable fate, the utterly tragic end.

Starring Kula Diamond from KOF: the vore ADV novel adapted from Bbrand's Freeze girl's meat hell CG series.
